title: Alternative Singpass Identity Options Apart from Facial Verification
what_it_is: Alternative Singpass Identity Options Apart from Facial Verification

sections.label: Singpass alternative verification methods
sections.summary: GovTech and MAS replied on alternative biometric or non-facial verification options for Singpass, with non-Singpass alternatives expected from organisations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: The Member may refer to The Straits Times Forum letter reply issued jointly by the Government Technology Agency (GovTech) and the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) on 4 February 2026, regarding alternative biometric or non-facial verification options for Singpass.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: As explained in the reply, there are alternative verification methods for users who are unable to use the facial recognition technology for reasons such as medical conditions or disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Organisations who have onboarded Singpass as a means for authentication are expected to have at least one non-Singpass alternative method for users.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: The Government will continue to work with relevant stakeholders on alternative methods to facial recognition technology for all users to maintain accessibility to digital services.

sections.label: Bank and government verification alternatives
sections.summary: MAS requires banks to have alternative verification methods, and government digital services are tested with citizens of all abilities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: MAS does require the banks to have alternative methods for verification.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: And for digital services that are offered by Government, we do make sure that we engage citizens across all ranges of abilities to test out our services, to ensure accessibility for all.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: On the point about public education, we can definitely do much better in communicating and explaining these different methods of access to our citizens.
